text: The rite of the Deposition from the Cross was performed at the Holy Trinity Cathedral.
The traditional rite of the Deposition was performed at the Holy Trinity Cathedral. The service symbolically depicts the burial and lamentation of the crucified Jesus Christ.
The ritual was conducted today by the Locum Tenens of the Patriarchal Throne, Metropolitan Shio (Mujiri) of Senaki and Chkhorotsqu, together with the hierarchs.
Today is Good Friday, the most somber day of Holy Week. The Orthodox Church commemorates the crucifixion of Jesus Christ, His descent from the cross, and His burial.

On Good Friday, the Divine Liturgy is not celebrated in churches because, according to the Gospel, the Lord sacrificed Himself to redeem humanity from sins. During the service, the Royal Hours are performed, during which the Gospel concerning the Passion of the Lord is read.
On this day, believers dye eggs red and also bake paskas because, according to the Gospel, the crucifixion of Jesus Christ took place during the Jewish Passover holiday.
